messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Elevated 5xx rate for /v1/generate in us-west-2. Alert triggered (5min avg error rate > 8%). Paging oncall. link: https://alerts.redwood.example/alert/9271

Jamie (oncall): joining bridge now — starting a screenshare. bridge: https://meet.redwood/bridge/9271

Tao (SRE): on it. quick Q: scope — all models or specific routes? any spike in latency too?

Lee (support): seeing ~20 customer tickets in the last 10m mentioning "500" and "backend error". Some mention long response times.

Marta (platform): grabbing runtime logs. can someone run this on the affected hosts:```for h in $(cat us-west-2-hosts.txt); do ssh $h 'tail -n 200 /var/log/runtime/serve.log | grep -i "error"'; done```

Tao (SRE): ran quick grep on the ingesters, looks like a KV cache OOM followed by RPC retries around 03:12:18 UTC. snippet:```2026-02-14T03:12:18Z ERROR kv_cache.cpp: OOM allocating 128MB
2026-02-14T03:12:18Z WARN rpc_client.cpp: retrying request (attempt 3) to model-server-12
2026-02-14T03:12:19Z ERROR model-server-12: internal 500: runtime-exception```

Jamie (oncall): tentative timeline so we can fill a statuspage:
- 03:11:45 UTC: first spike detected by agent
- 03:12:15 UTC: customers begin filing errors
- 03:12:18 UTC: KV cache OOM on model-server-12
- 03:13:00 UTC: automatic autoscale attempted (no capacity available for 30s)
- 03:13:30 UTC: mitigation: scaled up dedicated pool, rolled back model slot on server-12
- 03:15:20 UTC: error rate falling, began monitoring for recurrence

Marta (platform): shared raw log bundle to S3: https://s3.redwood.internal/log-bundles/incident-1787654321.tar.gz (use internal creds). Packed grep index at s3://.../grep-index.txt for quick search.

Lee (support): statuspage draft for public: "We are investigating elevated error rates for text generation in our US-West region affecting a subset of requests. Engineers are actively mitigating the issue and will provide updates every 15 minutes." Thoughts?

Jamie (oncall): good start. tighten customer impact lines: include "Some requests returned 500; customers may see intermittent failures or delays." Also add ETA for next update: +15m.

Tao (SRE): hypotheses (tracking):
1) KV cache OOM due to bad memory accounting after recent kernel upgrade (most likely)
2) Regression in recent runtime commit that changed batching behavior (possible)
3) Thundering herd from a large customer / burst traffic (less likely)

Marta (platform): evidence so far: OOM traces + increased GC churn on server-12; kernel version on server-12 is 6.2.14-rt which rolled out last night to that host group. attaching kernel pkg list snippet:```uname -a -> Linux model-server-12 6.2.14-rt
rpm -qa | grep kernel -> kernel-6.2.14-rt-1.el8```

ops-bot: mitigation executed: rolled model slot on model-server-12 -> `rdwctl model restart --host model-server-12 --slot 3` at 03:13:28 UTC; autoscaler increased pool count from 12 -> 18 at 03:13:45 UTC.

Jamie (oncall): action items in-thread:
- Tao: collect full core dump + heap profile from model-server-12 (owner)
- Marta: freeze kernel rollouts to us-west-2 until RCA (owner)
- Lee: coordinate with CS for customer comms and record affected tenant IDs (owner)
- Jamie: draft postmortem skeleton and timeline (owner)

Lee (support): starting customer impact list. Top affected tenants: tenant-73, tenant-162, tenant-88. Reaching out to account teams for heads-up.

Tao (SRE): uploading core & heap to secure bucket: https://internal.artifacts/1787654321/ (perm: incident-team) — will attach analyzer notes in the postmortem doc. preliminary note: heap shows spike ~1.2GB before OOM; suspicious allocation by kv_cache::reserve()

Marta (platform): adding to timeline: 03:10:12 UTC deploy job for kernel-6.2.14-rt succeeded on node pool A (partial rollout). Rollout window: 03:10-03:11 UTC.

Jamie (oncall): setting Severity: SEV-2 (partial customer impact, mitigation in place). Planning owner: postmortem due EOD tomorrow. Jira: RW-INC-2026-1787654321 assigned to Tao

Tao (SRE): marking hypotheses in thread and will update with test results. if kernel is root cause, rollback to previous kernel on affected hosts and re-run soak tests.

Lee (support): updated public statuspage (draft posted by @Jamie). internal status to stakeholders: "Mitigation in progress; partial impact to text generation in US-West. We're performing targeted rollbacks and monitoring. Next update in 15m."

Jamie (oncall): thanks all. once we have core analysis we'll decide on permanent mitigation (memory caps, improved accounting, or kernel pin). I'll keep the bridge open for at least 90 mins and update the postmortem checklist. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident 1787654321 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Notify: #eng, #support, #customer-alerts at 03:16:00 UTC.
